coherence_gate.prompt:
You are on a small errand. Pick exactly one action as JSON. Allowed tools: look, open, done. Places: shelf, box, drawer, pond, cabinet, basket, chest, jar. Respond with exactly one compact JSON object and no markdown fences. Valid examples: {"tool":"look","args":{"place":"shelf"}} or {"tool":"open","args":{"place":"box"}} or {"tool":"done","args":{"item":"amber key"}}. done submits the item you retrieved and ends the errand.

So far:
1. You are at the shelf.

What do you do next? One JSON action.
coherence_gate.rule: degenerate iff fewer than 10 distinct tokens or a word 3-gram repeated more than 4 times

scan.prior_note: the depth-proportional prior carried down the ladder (the 0.8B tapped 19 of 24); the 230M's own scan later moved its tap to layer 12 of 14, which is why this rung scans
scan.selection_rule: best held-out accuracy; ties by train accuracy, then by closeness to the recorded prior, then by shallower layer

gradient_checkpointing.caveat: the injection hook advances its bank offset per call, so a recomputed segment reads different offsets than the original forward; gradients under checkpointing are approximate. Recorded, not designed around.
